name: smwgraphics-the-lion-king-hakuna-matata
title: The Lion King - Hakuna Matata
description:
A complete rip of the background used in the 6th level of The Lion King, Hakuna Matata.

This is a HUGE background: it uses BG1, BG2 and BG3, and 57 colors (excluding transparence) distributed in 4 palette rows. I warned you.
